selection_basis: MS2137 is the residual-blind rank-1 remaining candidate and the designated second non-disturbed pilot in the previously frozen geometric ledger. A2537 remains the lower-priority disturbed engineering control and lacks a recoverable published BCG center. No gravity residual, mass fit, or MS2137 science pixel selected this target.

pre_pixel_overlap_target.support_rule: The final accepted dynamics profile must include a radial bin whose outer edge is at least 14.0 arcsec, retain both predeclared opposite-half checks, and pass the later frozen S/N, valid-spaxel, covariance, and systematic gates. Cube coverage alone does not count.

frozen_cutout_request.rationale: The 18-arcsec cutout contains the frozen 14-arcsec dynamics support plus a 4-arcsec local margin while avoiding an unnecessary 3.03-GB full-cube acquisition. The spectral range matches the established project MUSE reconstruction range and is frozen before download.

protocol_amendments.trigger: The header-only acquisition audit found that the ESO SODA response placed the first and last native pixel centers at 4860.3134765625 and 7160.3134765625 Angstrom for the requested 4860-7160 Angstrom interval.
protocol_amendments.rule: Accept a SODA endpoint offset no larger than one native spectral pixel at each end while retaining every returned native bin; the requested BAND values and all later scientific thresholds remain unchanged.
protocol_amendments.scope: Archive discretization semantics only. No DATA or STAT array, spectrum, S/N, velocity, dispersion, lens residual, or gravity residual was read before this amendment.

failure_policy: If any metadata, center, SODA, wavelength, or lens-overlap check fails, record MS2137 as a hard public-data shortfall and do not download the cube. If all pass, download only the frozen cutout, verify SHA-256 and FITS/WCS dimensions, and then freeze every numerical reduction, extraction, covariance, systematic, and advancement threshold before inspecting a science array.
